info.name: Reonic REST Api v3 Activities Contacts API

params.name: email
params.description: Return only contacts whose primary or secondary email equals this address (case-insensitive exact match). Useful for matching an incoming email to a contact.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Return only contacts whose phone or mobile number exactly matches this number. Must be in E.164 format (e.g. +491511234567). Useful for matching an incoming call to a contact. Numbers not stored in E.164 format cannot be matched by this filter.

params.name: createdAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where createdAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: createdAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where createdAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: updatedAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where updatedAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: updatedAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where updatedAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items per page. Default: 50. Max: 200.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Use field names for ascending (e.g. "createdAt"), minus sign for descending (e.g. "-createdAt"). Chain with commas (e.g. "createdAt,editedAt"). Sortable fields: fullName, createdAt. Defaults to -createdAt.
